europe_now.title: Greek Minister Urges Rapid Deportation of Rejected Asylum-Seekers
europe_now.summary: A Greek minister has called for rejected asylum-seekers to be removed from the European Union as quickly as possible. The remarks highlight ongoing discussions among member states regarding stricter border and migration controls.

europe_now.title: French PM Warns Against Escalation Following School Protests
europe_now.summary: The French Prime Minister issued a warning regarding the escalation of school protests after numerous individuals were arrested. Demonstrations and student actions continue to fuel political friction across the country.

top_stories.title: Pope Concludes France Visit
top_stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV has finished his four-day visit to France with a final stop in Metz. During the trip, he emphasized European unity and encouraged the region to foster global dialogue.

top_stories.title: French Wildfire Extinguished
top_stories.summary: Authorities in France have successfully extinguished the largest wildfire recorded in the country since 1949. The massive fire had torched a significant amount of land and smouldered for over two months.
